notes.title: Protect My Cheese Early Access V1.8 Update & Award Wins
notes.notes:
Hello folks🐭
We are excited to announce the release of Protect My Cheese Version 1.8 Early Access! This update brings several new features, balance adjustments for certain levels, and minor bug fixes.

Furthermore, we won several game awards from Indienesia Game Festival 2024:
🏆 Game of The Fest – 3rd Place
🏆 Best Art – 2nd Place
🏆 Best Gameplay – 2nd Place
🏆 Best Sound – 3rd Place
🏆 Best Story – 2nd Place
🏆 Most Fun Game – 2nd Place

Complete Changelogs:
[list]
[*]Added new Advanced Settings : Window Mode (Fullscreen & Windowed) & Show FPS option
[*]Sell Tower Confirmation: Players now need to double-click to sell a tower
[*]Fixed camera zoom bugs on infinite scroll mouse
[*]Ramps rotation for enemies applied to all levels
[*]Enhanced "Move Tower" system & fix bugs
[*]Fixed Achievement Initialization Issue
[*]Tweaked fast-forward speed from 1.5x to 1.6x & enemy spawn rate from 1.3s to 1.2s
[*]Fixed Level 10 Boss on wave 1
[*]Added new props & tower placement in level 10
[*]Fixed Enemy Death Animation not playing when not rendered
[*]Fixed flashing catnip icon when dragged
[*]Updated Start Game Cutscene and fixed scaling issue for ultrawide screens
[*]Tweaked Begone Damage +1
[*]Enhanced Optimizations: Up to +30% performance consistency and +15% FPS gain
[*]Fixed bugs on level 3, level 4, level 10
[*]Added hard difficulty indicator when level starts
[*]General Bug Fixes & Performance Optimizations
[/list]

Update the game now and protect your cheese 🧀!

notes.title: Game Pricing & Future Update Announcements
notes.notes:
Hello folks,
We are very happy to announce that Protect My Cheese will be available for FREE!
While the game is free to play for anyone, we won't implement any in-game purchases to make the game really FREE TO PLAY. 

We would want to express our gratitude to all of the players who have supported the game up to this point. Although this may be unfavorable news for some players, we'll keep adding new features and fixing bugs to the game!  

Stay tuned for more updates!
Sincerely

You may watch the game trailer here:

notes.title: Early Access 1.5 Update - New Tower & Enemies
notes.notes:
Thank you for your feedback while playing the game. We have collected a lot of feedback over the past few months and are ready to announce the next fix for that. 

[h3]Early Access 1.5 changelogs[/h3]
[b]Features[/b]
- New Enemy : Roachie
   Roachie came to get our cheese in a ridiculous size to feed an entire city. He can fly and will descend in 
   a short amount of time. (available in the next chapter)
- New Tower : Begone
  Begone will shoot poisinous smoke which will kill the enemy slowly. Effective against flying enemies. 
  (available on level 8 and above)
- Added the Update Changelog UI
- Poosi variations are now displayed in the Almanac
- The player can now move the tower even if the wave has not yet begun.
- A new alternative to dragging and dropping the tower has been added. Players can now click and drag towers onto the world.
- Discord button will appear at the mainmenu

[b]Bugs[/b]
- Fixed level 10 missing black decal on enemy spawn location
- Fixed flies slower movement due to glure projectile
- Fixed level 2 unconsistent blockage
-  Fixed  sluggish signal tower's tower boosted menu

[b]Balancing[/b]
- Enhanced visual effects and motion in the mainmenu
- Improved almanac interface
- Reduced spin wheel price
- Now player can skip the first cutscene
- Catnip spawn rate adjusted
- Opponents' health point tweaked
- Signal tower's upgrade price increased
- Peanon's damage adjusted
- Added sped up indicator and effects

Update the game now!
You may watch the game trailer here:
[previewyoutube=u-yPF0ktnc8;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Early Access 1.4 Update - 40+ Achievements & Game Balancing

- More hidden fishes scrambled across levels

[b]Bugs[/b]

- Added tower stun SFX
